seo.title: Factors of 100 Speed Grid - Percentages & Benchmark Divisors
seo.metaDescription: Click all 9 factors of 100 on an interactive 10x10 math grid. Master key divisor benchmarks for dollar money math and percentage calculations.
seo.intro: One hundred is the cornerstone of our decimal currency and percentage mathematics. Because 100 is a square number (10 x 10), it has an odd count of factors (9 in total): 1, 2, 4, 5, 10, 20, 25, 50, and 100. Spotting all 9 factors builds essential bridges between whole number division, fractions (1/4 = 25/100), and percentages.
seo.howToPlay: Identify and click all 9 factors of 100 on the grid. Correct factors turn green with a checkmark. Incorrect clicks flash red and penalize 2 seconds. Find all 9 factors to complete the round.
seo.teacherNotes: Directly relate the factors of 100 to United States currency: 1 cent (penny), 5 cents (nickel), 10 cents (dime), 25 cents (quarter), 50 cents (half dollar), and 100 cents (dollar).

faq.q: Why are factors of 100 useful in real life?
faq.a: They provide the exact coin values for money and simplify common percentages like 20%, 25%, and 50%.
